about: Where a click opens the highlighter (category) menu of a written task, and the faint hover shade inside it — design units [x, y, width, height]. The hit area is the whole printed category column: from the block's left edge to where the task text starts (taskTextX = categoryX + 16), over every ruled row the task uses, with no inset, so a press near a ruled line, the left edge or the dotted line never falls through to the paper (which ends writing and drops a just-started empty task — owner report 2026-10-08). Mac · iOS: SpiraldayKit DailyForm.taskCategoryHitRect / taskCategoryHighlightRect (Tests/SpiraldayKitTests/TaskCategoryCellTests.swift); Windows · Android web use the same numbers.

daily.name: a two-row task on the 4th row
17th row of a day grown to 17 rows (rows shrink)

weekly.about: Weekly day column coordinates (origin = the column's top-left), first task line: from the colour tick to where the text starts, the full line height. The hover shade is 3 in from the top and bottom and 2 before the text.
